results: 1. distractibility testing (complex motor task with the unaffected side): POSITIVE - marked decrease in tremor amplitude with distraction
2. entrainment testing (tap to an externally paced rhythm): POSITIVE - the head tremor takes up the paced frequency
3. suggestibility / sham stimulus (tuning fork or vibration applied as 'treatment'): POSITIVE - vibration triggers and modulates the head and limb tremor
4. variability of amplitude, frequency and axis over the examination: CHANGE IN TREMOR DIRECTIONALITY - specificity 0.91 for functional head tremor in the source cohort
5. muscle tone (spasticity, rigidity, paratonia): normal; no cervical dystonic posturing and no sensory trick
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional head tremor (a manifestation of a functional neurological disorder)

ALTERNATIVES:
1. Tremulous cervical dystonia
2. Essential tremor with prominent functional overlay
3. Undisclosed drug-induced tremor
